== Fields

=== `bind`

Whether to bind to the URLs and wait for peers to connect, instead of connecting to them.

*Type*: `bool`

*Default*: `false`

=== `high_water_mark`

The message high water mark to use.

*Type*: `int`

*Default*: `0`

=== `poll_timeout`

The poll timeout to use.

*Type*: `string`

*Default*: `5s`

=== `socket_type`

The socket type to connect as.

*Type*: `string`

*Options*: `PULL`, `SUB`

=== `sub_filters[]`

The topics that the socket subscribes to when `socket_type` is `SUB`. ZeroMQ delivers a message only when its first frame begins with one of these prefixes, so specifying a single sub_filter of `''` subscribes to everything. At least one filter is required with a SUB socket.

*Type*: `array<string>`

*Default*: `[]`

=== `urls[]`

A list of ZeroMQ endpoints to connect to, or to bind when `bind` is `true`, using a transport such as `tcp://`, `ipc://`, or `inproc://`. If an item in the list contains commas, it is split into multiple endpoints.

*Type*: `array<string>`

[source,yaml]
----
# Examples:
urls:
  - "tcp://localhost:5555"
----
